task_fulfillment.rationale: The single Word SOP substantially addresses warehouse handling, storage and training. R43 is incomplete. More materially, the ionizer schedule relies on a company ESD plan that the document says was not supplied, without explicitly requiring a discharge-time criterion before ionizer use. Define that criterion or prohibit reliance on ionizers until approved. Portable-kit availability is appropriately gated before go-live, not assumed operationally available. The reported four-page length is not independently verified because rendering was not performed; reference accuracy and human approval remain separate endpoints.
